issue_request: FHIR-18603 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary clarification for FHIR-core CodeSystem asking to change CodeSystem.identifier from "Additional identifier for the code system" to "Additional identifier for the code system (business identifier)" to align with ValueSet.identifier.
initial_application: The Jira comment identified git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. That October 2018 terminology ballot documentation commit touched the old CodeSystem spreadsheet source and included the business-identifier parenthetical for CodeSystem.identifier.
additional_context: CodeSystem and ValueSet are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current source was refactored from spreadsheets to StructureDefinition XML in 2021, and commit 33b409a4b6 preserved both CodeSystem.identifier and ValueSet.identifier business-identifier short text. Related earlier issue FHIR-16464 and its terminology Zulip clarification confirm that the CodeSystem wording should say code system rather than value set. Searches found no FHIR-18603/GF#18603 Zulip or Confluence evidence that conflicts with the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active CodeSystem StructureDefinition already says "Additional identifier for the code system (business identifier)", and the active ValueSet StructureDefinition still says "Additional identifier for the value set (business identifier)".
